title: F2 Dual-Ended Powder Brush
descriptionHtml:
✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Vegan

What it is: A dual-ended brush that seamlessly applies and blends bronzer or powders.

Brush Formulation: Powder


Ingredient Callouts: It is cruelty-free and vegan.


What Else You Need to Know: This double-ended, multiuse brush features large, fluffy hairs and a custom tapered shape, perfect for picking up and applying powders and bronzer with minimal fallout. It features the highest-quality patent-pending hairs, which mimic the finish and feel of natural hair.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-This brush pairs perfectly with all powder formulas, including blush, bronzer, highlighter, foundation, and setting powder.
-Use the fuller end to apply bronzer and the opposite side for blush or any powder product.
-Swirl the brush into your bronzer or blush pan and tap once to release excess product.
-Use the larger end of the brush to sweep bronzer across the high points of the face, like the cheekbones, nose, and along the hairline.
-Use the opposite end to apply powder brush to the apples of the cheeks.
